description: I'm a beginner in NASA Space Apps, but I'm enthusiastic, creative and willing to learn and contribute to the team.
summary: Space Learning is an educational platform that invites children aged 4-12 to explore space history and discover the stories behind historical space and machines and challenge them with an easy interactive quiz. This project provides an easily accessible and enjoyable way for young children to understand and explore human-made machines left on the Moon and Mars.
details: This project uses storytelling as the main creative approach, using Figma AI to create the website user interface and other AI tools for ideation and information gathering. Canva was also used to prepare the presentation slides. This project focused on making the complicated space knowledge to understand and visually attractive that is suitable for young children to explore.
